text:
### Timing  
**Submission Window:** Billers submit 3 days before payment date
**Processing:** FirstUK processes overnight (BACS)
**Settlement:** Funds reach biller next business day

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Submission and Settlement Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end process for direct debit submission by billers, overnight processing by FirstUK via BACS, and settlement of funds to billers. The process operates on a defined timeline with submission 3 days before payment date, overnight processing, and next business day settlement.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
FirstUK processes overnight (BACS)
Funds reach biller next business day

raw_entities.name: Biller Submission
raw_entities.description: Billers submit direct debit instructions 3 days prior to the scheduled payment date. This step initiates the direct debit processing cycle.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date

raw_entities.name: Overnight BACS Processing
raw_entities.description: FirstUK processes all submitted direct debit instructions overnight using the BACS (Bankers' Automated Clearing Services) system. This automated step handles the clearing and settlement preparation.
context: FirstUK processes overnight (BACS)

raw_entities.name: Settlement to Biller
raw_entities.description: Processed funds are settled and reach the biller's account on the next business day following overnight processing. This completes the direct debit cycle.
context: Funds reach biller next business day

raw_entities.name: Biller
raw_entities.description: External organization that submits direct debit instructions to FirstUK and receives settlement of funds. Billers initiate the process by submitting payment instructions 3 days before the payment date.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Processing System
raw_entities.description: Automated system responsible for receiving biller submissions, processing direct debit instructions overnight via BACS, and orchestrating settlement to billers. Acts as the central clearing and settlement engine.
context: FirstUK processes overnight (BACS)

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Mandate
